mapper.sql: t.id, t.body, t.likes_count, t.reposts_count, t.replies_count, t.pinned, t.created_at, t.attachment_kind, t.attachment_track_id, t.image, c.name AS channel_name, a.id AS author_id, a.nickname AS author_name, a.handle AS author_handle, a.avatar_hue AS author_hue, a.city AS author_city, a.role AS author_role, a.verified AS author_verified, a.followers_count AS author_followers, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tt.tag ORDER BY tt.tag) FROM post_tag tt WHERE tt.thread_id = t.id) AS tags, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_like lk WHERE lk.thread_id = t.id AND lk.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_save sv WHERE sv.thread_id = t.id AND sv.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS saved, tr.title AS att_title, tr.cover AS att_cover, tr.duration_sec AS att_duration, tr.bpm AS att_bpm
FROM post t JOIN app_user a ON a.id = t.author_id JOIN channel c ON c.id = t.channel_id LEFT JOIN track tr ON tr.id = t.attachment_track_id

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_tag tt2 WHERE tt2.thread_id = t.id AND tt2.tag = #{tag})

if.test: following != null and following and viewerId != null

mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.parent_id, r.body, r.likes_count, r.created_at, a.id AS author_id, a.nickname AS author_name, a.handle AS author_handle, a.avatar_hue AS author_hue, a.city AS author_city, a.role AS author_role, a.verified AS author_verified, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reply_like rl WHERE rl.reply_id = r.id AND rl.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked FROM post_reply r JOIN app_user a ON a.id = r.author_id WHERE r.thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (author_id, channel_id, body, pinned, attachment_kind, attachment_track_id, image) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{channelId}, #{body}, #{pinned}, #{attachmentKind}, #{attachmentTrackId}, #{image})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET likes_count = GREATEST(0, likes_count + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET replies_count = GREATEST(0, replies_count + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_like (user_id, thread_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{threadId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND thread_id = #{threadId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND thread_id = #{threadId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_save (user_id, thread_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{threadId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_save WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND thread_id = #{threadId}
